text_block_list.text:
—This year's summer training camp has come 
to an end. After accompanying Symboli 
Rudolf to see off all the students, we 
boarded the final bus, and then...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if everyone managed to grow 
and mature safely this year as well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Did I accomplish the goals I set for 
myself? Can I truly feel the fruits of my 
summer efforts?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We left much more to everyone's initiative 
than usual. I watched over them as they 
worked hard, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Overprotective as ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, overprotective, huh? I'm fully 
aware of it, though."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Never mind other people, did you train 
properly yourself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"There are no oversights there. Right, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Brian, have you finished your 
final check?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Air Groove will be here soon too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see, we'll be heading out shortly then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What are you smiling about?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, the ones taking the last bus are me, 
Trainer, and..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With you, Air Groove, and the four of 
us... It's truly a deeply moving lineup, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've caused you all a lot of trouble up 
until now. And besides—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
We'll save what comes after for when the 
"Empress" gets here, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I hate sentimental stuff like that. I'll 
leave noddin' along to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yet, you still lend an ear. That is 
your kindness showing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You really are kind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No, I'm saying—... Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President, sorry to keep you waiting—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Why is Brian wearing a blanket in this 
heat?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"However, as with the other committee 
members... I am truly blessed with 
wonderful peers."

After that, the bus departed and slowly 
made its way back to the academy...
